targetText: This is the law that continually throws capitalist production out of its old ruts and compels capital to strain ever more the productive forces of labour for the very reason that it has already strained them
explanation: Competition forces capitalists to continuously innovate, automate, and increase labor efficiency just to maintain their existing market position.

targetText: If we now conceive this feverish agitation as it operates in the market of the whole world, we shall be in a position to comprehend how the growth, accumulation, and concentration of capital bring in their train an ever more detailed subdivision of labour
explanation: Global capitalist competition accelerates technological automation and specialization, leading to the concentration of wealth into larger monopoly enterprises.
